answer: To raise Sybil cost, each new agent must stake a refundable bond that only unlocks after its attestations survive N peer reviews across distinct epochs. Fake identities cannot wander in cheaply: forging reviews needs paid compute and stake slash risk. Route bonds through a juniper-hashed commitment queue so sockpuppets cannot recycle the same collateral. Publish bond burn rates on a public terrace board; attackers then face linear stake loss per fake node rather than free replication.
